works.workDescription: e-Commerce application developed in collaboration with classmates using PHP, HTML, and the Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture. Designed as an educational platform, it allowed us to apply theoretical concepts in a real-world scenario by building a functional online store. The application supports basic e-commerce funcionalities such as product listing, cart management, and user interactions, with a focus on clean code structure and teamwork.
